messages:
Nina: heads-up 1 opened a small PR to standardize error message tone and a few glossary entries. main changes: drop 'Please' from inline errors, use sentence case for messages, and standardize 'retryable' vs 'transient'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/621
Carlos: nice. we should prefer active voice for errors (e.g., 'Request timed out' not 'The request has timed out'). also agree on sentence case. :+1:
Ravi: question on 'retryable' vs 'transient' 1 which do we prefer in user-facing migration guides? infra teams use 'transient' in logs.
Claire: my vote is 'retryable' in user-facing docs and 'transient' in logs/telemetry. makes it clearer for product folks. can we add a glossary alias?
Nina: yes. proposed glossary line: "retryable (aka transient) 1 prefer 'retryable' in guides and SDK error docs; keep 'transient' in logs/telemetry." I'll add it to docs/glossary.yml in the PR.
Carlos: also saw inconsistency in endpoint naming: some examples use `/v1/generate` and others `/generate.v1`. choose one. we prefer REST-style: `/v1/generate`.
Ravi: agreed. note: CLI examples still reference `generate.v1` in a couple of places. I'll open a tiny patch after this merges.
Claire: microcopy nit: remove trailing periods in inline code comments (e.g., `# returns error.` -> `# returns error`). small but helps scan.
style-bot: reminder: glossary search needs permalinks to surface aliases. created issue #934 to add anchors.
Nina: added a PR note: "follow-up: run site search indexing after glossary anchors are added (issue #934)". keeping this PR scoped to copy changes only.
Carlos: one more thing 1 in SDK snippets we currently do `model: "Redwood-Opt-1"` in examples. product wants canonical handle `redwood-opt-1` (lower kebab). please update sample handles to canonical casing.
Ravi: I'll batch the model-handle changes into the post-merge PR for language-specific samples (JS/TS camelCase param names, Python snake_case).
Claire: can we add a single-line rule to style guide: "Prose: lowercase terms (e.g., 'model family'); Code: use canonical identifiers and preserve exact casing (kebab/snake/camel per-language)."
Nina: done in PR description. moving to reviewers. thanks all 680
